svg.title: Holding the tank level
svg.desc: On the identified tank, a PI with a fast integral is predicted to overshoot a 0.1 metre target step by 43 percent and ring; the automatically tuned PI, validated on the actual ST, peaks at 1.119 metres and stays within 0.01 metres from 34.6 seconds, and after the outlet draws 10 percent more the level dips to 0.958 metres and is back within 0.01 metres at 41.5 seconds. The fastest P would settle 0.098 metres low.
svg.text: Holding the tank level: a fast integral rings, the tuned PI does not
